Name: The Gentleman's Classic Shoe Shine Kit
Natural: This is the hardwood case that elegantly stores all the necessary supplies for a traditional shoe shine. With a contoured footrest on top that provides a sturdy base while working, the kits large brush pre-cleans dirt and debris from footwear before the small round brush is used to apply the polish. Both brushes are made from natural horsehair, whose soft, dense bristles work gently on leather without scratching. The black and brown polishes match the finish on most mens and womens footwear, and the two soft cloths (one for each color) provide the final luster. The large kit has ample space for storing additional supplies such as shoehorns, spare laces, and additional polish. The cases unique design and solid construction with stainless steel hinges ensures years of use. 12 1/2" L x 6 1/2" H x 6 1/4" D. (5 lbs.)
